definitions.explanation: A physical space or opening between things.

definitions.gloss: unguarded moment, opening, chance to exploit
definitions.explanation: A moment of carelessness or vulnerability that can be taken advantage of. Common in martial arts, sports, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {隙|すき}を{狙|ねら}って{攻撃|こうげき}した。
{隙|すき}を{見|み}せたら{負|ま}ける。
examples.english: If you show any opening, you'll lose.

examples.japanese: {戸|と}の{隙|すき}から{冷|つめ}たい{風|かぜ}が{入|はい}ってくる。
examples.english: Cold air comes in through the gap in the door.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{隙|すき}をついて{一気|いっき}に{攻|せ}めた。
examples.english: I exploited my opponent's opening and attacked all at once.

notes:
{隙|すき} has two main uses: a physical gap and a figurative opening or vulnerability.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隙|すき}を{狙|ねら}う (target an opening)
- {隙|すき}をつく (exploit an opening)
- {隙|すき}を{見|み}せる (show vulnerability)
- {隙|すき}がない (have no openings, be on guard)
- {隙|すき}だらけ (full of openings)

RELATED WORD:
- {隙間|すきま}: gap, crack, space between things (more concrete/physical than {隙|すき})

Not to be confused with {好|す}き (liking, fondness), which has the same reading.
